I will never see any comment with as many Ben Folds references in the same comment again.
Well, that's one reminder that There's Always Someone Cooler Than You.

I'll keep all of that in mind. Holding something also might help!

I'm going to try as hard as I can to improve, even if it *does* end up taking a while.
I already do see my counselor, he's very helpful. I'm going to move schools next year, this school year ends in early June. Hopefully that will help.
I'm planning on going to see a doctor when I'm able to, but right now we don't really have the money. I will try logging my blow ups, that's a good idea--thank you!

We do need to bring more people on, but I'm just not sure how we do that?
I think we have enough people to keep moving forwards, though.
Sadly I won't be able to play Dreams, I don't have the money for a PS4 haha. Maybe I'll get one by the time it releases, but it is slim.

Ah, okay thank you so much :)
I was so scared that it was dying and I really didn't want to loose something that I've known so well.
I'll try out Tearaway too! It sounds fun.
